Usage: codex [options] [command]

Codex CLI

Commands:
  exec          Run a task non-interactively (supports --json for structured output)
  goal          Run until a completion condition is met, checking progress each pass
  apply         Apply a generated patch

Options:
  --json                       Emit JSON events on stdout
  --full-auto                  Run with full automation, no prompts

Slash commands:
  /diff
  /explain
